introduction.p1: At Grow Online, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your data when you use our Services.
introduction.p2: The data controller responsible for your personal data is:
introduction.controllerInfo: Bastien Youssfi (micro-entreprise), 18 mail Renaissance, 95200 Ermont, France
introduction.p3: This policy applies to all users worldwide and is designed to comply with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), and other applicable privacy laws.

list.item1: Email address and name when you register
list.item2: Profile picture (if provided)
list.item3: Password (encrypted and securely stored)
list.item4: Billing information (processed by Stripe, not stored by us)

list.item1: OAuth tokens to connect your social media accounts
list.item2: Profile information from connected platforms (username, avatar, followers)
list.item3: Content you create, schedule, or publish through our Platform
list.item4: Analytics and engagement data from your connected accounts

dataUse.p1: We use your personal data for the following purposes:

list.item1: To provide, maintain, and improve our Services
list.item2: To authenticate your identity and manage your account
list.item3: To connect and interact with your social media accounts on your behalf

list.item7: To analyze usage patterns and optimize user experience
list.item8: To detect, prevent, and address security issues and fraud

list.item2: Legitimate Interests: Analytics, security, and service improvement

list.item4: Legal Obligation: Compliance with applicable laws and regulations

legalBasis.p2: You may withdraw consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of processing based on consent before its withdrawal.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.subtitle: How we use cookies and similar technologies

whatAreCookies.title: 1. What Are Cookies
whatAreCookies.p1: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently and provide information to website owners.
whatAreCookies.p2: Cookies can be "persistent" (remain on your device until deleted) or "session" cookies (deleted when you close your browser).

howWeUse.title: 2. How We Use Cookies
howWeUse.p1: We use cookies and similar technologies for the following purposes:

list.item1: To keep you signed in to your account
list.item2: To remember your preferences and settings
list.item3: To understand how you use our Platform
list.item4: To improve our Services based on usage patterns
list.item5: To ensure the security of your account

essential.title: Essential Cookies
essential.text: These cookies are necessary for the Platform to function properly. They enable core features like authentication, security, and session management. You cannot opt out of these cookies.
essential.examples: Examples: Session cookies, authentication tokens, CSRF protection

analytics.title: Analytics Cookies
analytics.text: We use PostHog for analytics to understand how visitors interact with our Platform. These cookies help us improve our Services by collecting anonymous usage data.
analytics.examples: Examples: Page views, feature usage, session duration
analytics.optOut: You can opt out of analytics cookies through our cookie consent banner.

thirdParty.title: 4. Third-Party Cookies
thirdParty.p1: When you connect social media accounts, those platforms may set their own cookies. We do not control these cookies. Please refer to each platform's cookie policy:

list.item1: Google/YouTube: https://policies.google.com/technologies/cookies
list.item2: Facebook/Instagram: https://www.facebook.com/policies/cookies
list.item3: Twitter/X: https://twitter.com/privacy
list.item4: LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/legal/cookie-policy

duration.title: 5. Cookie Duration
duration.p1: The cookies we use have different lifespans:

list.item1: Session cookies: Deleted when you close your browser
list.item2: Authentication cookies: Up to 30 days (or until you log out)
list.item3: Preference cookies: Up to 1 year
list.item4: Analytics cookies: Up to 1 year

managing.title: 6. Managing Cookies
managing.p1: You can manage cookies in several ways:

consent.title: Cookie Consent Banner
consent.text: When you first visit our Platform, you can choose which optional cookies to accept or reject.

browser.title: Browser Settings
browser.text: Most browsers allow you to block or delete cookies. However, blocking all cookies may affect your ability to use our Platform.

settings.title: Platform Settings
settings.text: You can update your cookie preferences at any time through our cookie settings.

managing.p2: Note: If you disable essential cookies, you may not be able to access certain features or use the Platform at all.

changes.title: 7. Changes to This Policy
changes.p1: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for legal, operational, or regulatory reasons.
changes.p2: We will notify you of any significant changes by updating the "Last updated" date and, where appropriate, providing additional notice.
